desc: Diagnostic-only tethered networking discriminator. Chainload exact window-free object /Users/damsleth/Code/linux-build-out/m1n1-b0-dwm-m1n1-acm-wifi-usb-diag.bin SHA256 8ef1da54546334f82783f1522c41a3eb51e1eedfe9ff50f8b7610bc73a049c56 size 31817728 (1942x16KiB). It retains pinned graphical/MACSMC DTB 11abca72, observable feature kernel 217b4bd7 with USB storage/usbnet + BCM4388 firmware, and reproducible minilzlib-safe initramfs bd47a366. Only target delta is a Linux ConfigFS device-mode gadget shaped like m1n1: 1209:316d, CDC device class, self-powered 500mA config, two ACM functions; no SPMI/PCIe-PHY/PMU/SMC/NVRAM/firmware write. First PASS = macOS creates modem tty and reaches ttyGS0 shell. If native CDC still does not attach, compile-checked host helper scripts/t6040-usb-bulk-pty.c SHA256 e4131b13b8bfa460b08e23638874b2d1f1c797ada255b8c5596a0a795f01beda dynamically claims the Linux product's ACM bulk endpoints and bridges them to a PTY; it fail-closes on product string and refuses m1n1's proxy despite shared VID/PID. FALLBACK PASS = that PTY reaches ttyGS0, making PPP a separate follow-up. NEGATIVE = UDC configured but neither path carries bytes. Requires Claude exact-artifact/helper review and CJ approval; one chainload, then restore quiescent proxy.
